description:
Forward Deployed Engineer

 Location: New York City

 Compensation: $100,000 – $125,000

 About Us

 Eulerity is a fast-growing, AI-native marketing automation platform transforming how franchises and small businesses approach digital advertising. Built by former leaders from Google, Facebook, and Yahoo!, our platform combines decades of experience in engineering and marketing to deliver an industry-leading, automated solution. We serve enterprise brands like Mastercard, UPS Store, Uber Eats, and European Wax Center, automating digital advertising across thousands of franchise locations.

 The Role

 This role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and technical account management. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the technical anchor for our clients. You will bridge the gap between our internal engineering teams and our enterprise partners, ensuring that our APIs, SDKs, and marketing technologies are implemented seamlessly. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, ships fast, and is comfortable rolling up their sleeves to write glue code one minute and presenting a technical demo to a key client the next.

 Responsibilities

 
 
 Give compelling and clear technical demos to our clients to showcase platform capabilities and integration processes.



 
 Work directly with our clients to deploy our APIs, SDKs, and UXs into their existing architectures.



 
 Write basic glue code and make basic API calls to facilitate smooth and customized client integrations.



 
 Troubleshoot campaigns, investigating where issues may be stemming from and how to rectify problems.



 
 Work cross-functionally with various teams, including Account Management and Engineering, for any technical initiatives or issues.



 
 Translate complex technical discussions into clear requirements that engineers actually want to build from.



 
 Actively explore and implement AI tools to streamline repetitive tasks and campaign processes.



 
 Requirements

 
 
 Hands-on ability to write basic glue code and successfully execute API integrations.



 
 Comfort reading code, querying data, and debugging technical issues in client-facing environments.



 
 Strong analytical mindset with comfort interpreting campaign data and performance metrics.



 
 You are a fast, clear communicator—written, verbal, and in a whiteboard session.



 
 Self-starter mentality with a collaborative, team-first attitude.



 
 Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States of America without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.



 
 Based in NYC (or the tri-state area) and able to commit to 3–4 days in the Midtown office.



 
 Compensation & Benefits

 
 
 Salary Range: $100,000 – $125,000



 
 Health: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits.



 
 Time Off: Unlimited PTO and Summer Fridays.



 
 Retirement: 401(k) with company match.



 
 Office Perks: In-office free lunch, unlimited snacks, and commuter benefits.
